skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental concepts in financial and monetary theories, including financial systems, national budget, corporate finance, credit and interest rates, financial markets, commercial banking, central banking, monetary policy, and inflation.
Apply knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems in financial and monetary contexts, evaluate relevant regulations, and assess economic scenarios.
Demonstrate ability to work independently and in diverse teams, including presenting and collaborating effectively.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze complex financial and monetary issues and propose solutions.
Solve practical problems in financial and monetary contexts using theoretical knowledge.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats, including presenting findings and collaborating in group settings.
Conduct research on financial and monetary topics, including gathering and analyzing data.
Understand the structure and operations of financial markets, including various financial instruments and market activities.
Analyze and evaluate monetary policies and their impacts on the economy.
Understand corporate finance principles and practices, including financial planning, capital structure, and investment decisions.
Understand the role and functions of central banks in managing monetary policy and financial stability.
Analyze causes and effects of inflation and propose measures to manage it.
Evaluate economic policies and their implications for financial and monetary systems.
